triggers.name: RTN + Reclaim — Morning Post (7 AM ET)
triggers.prompt_summary: Education/authority slot. Uses morning product from daily rotation. Generates Higgsfield women image for Revitalize, men image for Reclaim. Posts via Composio to both Instagram accounts using explicit account aliases (instagram_cardin-bulgar, instagram_medlar-slap). Verifies each post is live via INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA before logging. No explicit Facebook call — Revitalize IG auto-syncs to Facebook.

triggers.name: RTN + Reclaim — Afternoon Post (3 PM ET)
triggers.prompt_summary: Pain-point slot. 3 PM crash content. Uses afternoon product from daily rotation. Same verified posting pattern as morning trigger.

triggers.name: RTN + Reclaim — Evening Post (7 PM ET)
triggers.prompt_summary: Conversion/transformation slot. Same verified posting pattern as morning/afternoon, plus best-effort YouTube video upload for Reclaim (does not block Instagram logging on failure).

triggers.name: Revitalize & Thrive — Evening YouTube Post (7 PM ET)
triggers.prompt_summary: YouTube video generation for Revitalize & Thrive Now channel. Fires at same time as evening Instagram trigger. Requires Higgsfield video generation and YouTube Data API v3 integration. Currently blocked on infrastructure implementation (discovered Sep 18, 2026).

triggers.name: Revitalize & Thrive — Night YouTube Post (10 PM ET)
triggers.prompt_summary: YouTube video generation for Revitalize & Thrive Now channel. Fires at 10 PM ET / 02:03 UTC (next day). Requires Higgsfield video generation and YouTube Data API v3 integration. Currently blocked on infrastructure implementation (discovered Sep 19, 2026).

triggers.name: RTN + Reclaim — Night Post (10 PM ET)
triggers.prompt_summary: Restoration / gentle wind-down slot. 10 PM bedtime content — protect tonight's rest so tomorrow starts stronger. Uses the night product from the daily rotation (sleep/restoration-leaning). Same verified posting pattern as the other slots: Higgsfield women image for Revitalize + men image for Reclaim, post via Composio to both Instagram accounts (instagram_cardin-bulgar, instagram_medlar-slap) with explicit account aliases, verify each post live via INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA before logging, no explicit Facebook call (Revitalize IG auto-syncs). cron 3 2 * * * UTC = 10 PM ET during EDT (adjust to 3 3 * * * for EST).
triggers.creation_command: mcp__Claude_Code_Remote__create_trigger with cron '3 2 * * *' and the prompt used by the other slots, targeting branch claude/laughing-darwin-cQTwH. Must be run in a session where the Claude_Code_Remote MCP server is connected.
